items.text:
This is a game where you start off as an exploited worker on a corporate-run space station, barely scraping by with the money you get from salvaging derelict spaceships. But unlike in other games, you don't have to stay there. Instead of selling all that scrap, you can take and build your own ship with it. You can expand your existing ship, add rooms, build a reactor from scrap parts, and in the end you will have a ship that you know is yours. Not your character's, but yours. 

This games gives you a feeling of ownership and reality like none I have ever played. Every piece of bulkhead, every deckplate, every oxygen sensor, every oxygen pump, every electrical conduit is something you, the player, put there. Nothing is quite as satisfying as walking through the ship that you built, sleeping in the bedroom you made, then taking the ship around the solar system.

There are so many moments of organic storytelling here. One time, as I docked with a derelict, a pirate came on board and told me it was now his ship. I armed myself ready to fight, but it seemed like his heart really wasn't in it, and we ended up bantering about sports instead, and then after a few minutes of that, I asked him to leave my ship and he did. He went back onto the derelict and just sort of hung out there for a bit. I ended up feeling sorry for him and hiring him on as a crew member. He proved very useful as he was a hard worker who worked quickly to help me build my ship up, and he had hacking skills too, which came in handy on getting the good stuff out of the PDAs we found on the derelicts we were salvaging. After a few weeks, he quit. We parted companny amicably, and then he walked off my ship and onto the station, where he was immediately tackled by security and arrested. I never said he was smart.

The whole solar system is modeled here, distances and travel times are realistic, and even with your powerful torch drive engines driven by your fusion reactor, a trip to the outer planets can take weeks. And it reallys creates a sense of immersion spending that time living on your ship, going through daily meals, wishing you'd installed a few more creature comforts, maybe a TV or an arcade game cabinet, or a more comfortable bed, and it is genuinely cathartic when you finally reach your destination.

There are a few gripes, sure. While the Venus colonies are beautiful and have lots of stuff to explore, and your starting base of K-LEG feels suitably gritty, a lot of the rest of the system feels a bit under-developed. The AI can occasionally be stupid, which can be frustrating when you need them to do something for you. A lot of the in-game quests are broken, but none of those are really what the game is about. It's a game about being a spacer, and in that regard the experience is unmatched.

—Written by a human being.
items.text_zh:
这是一款游戏，你一开始是一家公司运营的空间站上的一名被剥削的工人，靠打捞废弃飞船赚来的钱勉强糊口。但与其他游戏不同，你不必一直待在那里。与其卖掉所有那些废料，你可以用它们来建造自己的飞船。你可以扩建现有的飞船，增加房间，用废料零件建造反应堆，最终你会拥有一艘你知道是属于你的飞船。不是你角色的，而是你的。

这款游戏给了我一种前所未有的归属感和真实感。每一块舱壁、每一块甲板、每一个氧气传感器、每一个氧气泵、每一条电缆导管，都是你，玩家，亲手放置的。没有什么比走过自己建造的飞船、睡在自己打造的卧室里、然后驾驶飞船环游太阳系更令人满足的了。

这里有太多有机叙事的时刻。有一次，当我与一艘废弃飞船对接时，一个海盗上了船，告诉我这现在是他的飞船了。我武装好自己准备战斗，但他似乎并不真心想打，结果我们反而聊起了体育，几分钟后，我让他离开我的飞船，他就走了。他回到那艘废弃飞船上，就在那里待了一会儿。我最后为他感到难过，就雇他当了船员。他证明非常有用，因为他是个勤奋的人，干活很快，帮我建造飞船，而且他还有黑客技能，这在从我们打捞的废弃飞船上找到的PDA中提取好东西时派上了用场。几周后，他辞职了。我们友好地分道扬镳，然后他走下我的飞船，走上空间站，在那里他立刻被安保人员扑倒并逮捕了。我从没说过他聪明。

整个太阳系都在这里被建模，距离和旅行时间都很真实，即使有你由聚变反应堆驱动的强大火炬引擎，前往外行星的旅程也可能需要数周。而花那些时间生活在你的飞船上，经历日常三餐，希望自己多装了一些舒适设施，也许是一台电视或一个街机柜，或者一张更舒适的床，这真的营造出一种沉浸感，当你最终到达目的地时，那是一种真正的宣泄。

当然，也有一些抱怨。虽然金星殖民地很美丽，有很多东西可以探索，而且你的起始基地K-LEG感觉也足够粗粝，但太阳系其余大部分地方感觉有点开发不足。AI有时会很蠢，当你需要它们为你做某事时，这可能会令人沮丧。很多游戏内任务都坏了，但这些都不是这款游戏真正的内容。这是一款关于成为一名太空人的游戏，在这方面，体验是无与伦比的。

——由人类撰写。

items.text:
EDIT FOR 1.0.

This has become an exceptional game. The thing that impresses me most is coming up on the 1.0 release the devs went to Reddit (and Discord) and asked, "What needs the most attention?" By far people said "AI!!!"  And the devs listened! The last several patches have vastly improved the AI.

Overall, this is a great life/work simulator. I cannot recommend it enough.


With 115 hours in the game, it is obviously something that I would recommend. It is a very chill game. You play as a person in a dystopia future where much of humanity is stuck in space. You manage to get a ship, and work scraping or refurbishing ships in the scrapyard. There are survival elements without it being too stressful.

My recommendation does come with some caveats that will hopefully be addressed by launch (I will update the review if so). There's some jankiness with the game currently. A few AI issues concerning crew. And in my view, the game might be a bit too easy. As mentioned above, there are survival elements but really you never feel in that much danger, and you quickly have enough money that you will never be in any survival danger.

The devs are currently in the process of adding combat and fire. This may change things.

Overall, a solid game that needs a bit of polish in a few areas, but the devs are very active, and really listen to the community. Well worth supporting in my opinion, and you can currently have a lot of fun with the game.
items.text_zh:
为1.0版本而编辑。

这已经成为一款非凡的游戏。最让我印象深刻的是，在1.0发布临近时，开发者们去了Reddit（和Discord）问：“最需要关注的是什么？”绝大多数人说“AI！！！”而开发者们听取了意见！最近几个补丁极大地改进了AI。

总的来说，这是一款很棒的生活/工作模拟器。我怎么推荐都不够。


游戏时间115小时，这显然是我会推荐的东西。这是一款非常放松的游戏。你扮演一个反乌托邦未来中的人，那时人类大部分都被困在太空里。你设法弄到一艘船，在废料场靠拆解或翻新船只干活。有生存元素，但不会太有压力。

我的推荐确实附带一些保留意见，希望正式发布时能得到解决（如果解决了，我会更新评测）。目前游戏有些粗糙感。关于船员还有一些AI问题。而且在我看来，游戏可能有点太简单了。如上所述，有生存元素，但实际上你从不觉得自己身处多大危险之中，而且你很快就会拥有足够的钱，永远不会陷入任何生存危险。

开发者目前正在添加战斗和火灾。这可能会改变一些东西。

总的来说，这是一款扎实的游戏，在几个方面还需要一点打磨，但开发者非常活跃，而且真的会倾听社区意见。在我看来很值得支持，而且你现在就可以从这款游戏里获得很多乐趣。

items.text:
Has some work to still be done, but what is present is playable and fun for a sandbox style space game. Most issues I've encountered I find more humorous than annoying, and it is beyond easy to miss hours of your day doing something as simple as figuring out how you want to lay out your ship. Would recommend to anyone looking for a more challenging game, it barely holds your hand at the start (for now) and you have to read and play to fully grasp how to get going. Thoroughly enjoyable, and the devs are doing a great job supporting the game and squashing problems in a very timely manner.

Best bug so far I've encountered so far? Careening off into space at 1 km/s after the police try to dock and board me, only to send me flying off while they instead dock with the derelict I'm about to go salvage.
items.text_zh:
还有一些工作要做，但目前已有的内容对于一款沙盒风格的太空游戏来说是可玩且有趣的。我遇到的大多数问题，我觉得与其说是烦人，不如说是好笑，而且你很容易就会在像规划飞船布局这样简单的事情上不知不觉花掉好几个小时。会推荐给任何想找一款更有挑战性的游戏的人，它在开局时几乎不给你任何引导（目前如此），你必须通过阅读和游玩才能完全掌握如何上手。非常令人享受，而且开发者们在支持游戏和非常及时地解决问题方面做得非常出色。

到目前为止我遇到的最棒的bug？在警察试图停靠并登船时，我以1公里/秒的速度飞向太空，结果他们把我撞飞了，而他们反而停靠到了我正要去打捞的那艘废弃飞船上。

items.text:
After wasting 9 years of my youth working as a shipbreaker for the KLEG quadrant I finally got a break.  A ship, barely functional at start!  With some love and elbow grease I got her looking clean, and we were off to be our OWN boss.  

Barely out the gate, it finally dawns on me... I have no idea what I am doing. As I hastily read the scrolled notes of the previous owner, I get an idea for how to move the ship.  It takes a lot less than I would think to move this small ship.  Something else I come to realize fast is I don't have a lot of fuel, so I travel very slowly.
I find the manual while the ship is in transit and give it a good read.  Still don't know how to operate it, but it makes me feel better.

Docking is easier than I expected, and salvaging is time consuming.  Finally have a ship loaded with garbage and I return to my Nav station to begin the return journey...  It is always the dull moment that seem to need more life.  I get nailed by a cop doing an inspection.  They ask me why I was boarded, but I have no clue.  Get nailed for a fine because I don't have an employee sign up.  I saw this sign at tutorial, and didn't think anything of it.  He leaves me with my haul of crap and I begin again towards a place to sell this.  Luck and terror than strike twice!  I am nearing the asteroid OKLG when suddenly "error" begins to repeat on loop.  This wouldn't be too much a scare, except my proximity alarm is also going off.  Panic begins to set in as I look for some resource that can help me.  I work to debug the problems as the beeping slowly accelerates to a fever pitch.  EUREKA!, I go to sit back down and start tapping back to slow down.  Either by fate or dumb luck, I slow it enough.  I still THUD the dock, but I didn't die; and I don't think they are any the wiser.
items.text_zh:
在KLEG星区当了9年拆船工，浪费了我的青春之后，我终于得到了一个喘息的机会。一艘船，刚开始时几乎无法运作！凭着一些爱心和苦干，我把它弄得干干净净，然后我们就出发去当自己的老板了。

刚出门，我终于意识到……我根本不知道自己在干什么。我匆忙翻阅前船主留下的滚动笔记，对如何移动这艘船有了点想法。移动这艘小船所需的力气比我想象的要少得多。我很快意识到的另一件事是，我的燃料不多，所以我航行得非常慢。
船在航行途中，我找到了手册，好好读了一遍。还是不知道怎么操作它，但这让我感觉好多了。

停靠比我想象的容易，而打捞则很耗时。终于把一艘船装满了垃圾，我回到我的导航站开始返程……总是那些无聊的时刻似乎需要更多生气。我被一个做检查的警察逮住了。他们问我为什么被登船检查，但我完全不知道。因为我没有雇员登记而被罚了款。我在教程里见过这个标志，当时没当回事。他留下我和我那一堆破烂，我又开始朝一个能卖掉这些东西的地方前进。幸运与恐惧接着又来了两次！我正接近OKLG小行星时，突然“错误”开始循环重复。这本来不会太吓人，只是我的接近警报也在响。当我寻找能帮上忙的资源时，恐慌开始袭来。我努力调试问题，而哔哔声慢慢加速到狂热的顶点。找到了！我回去坐下，开始敲击减速。不知是命运还是傻运气，我减速得足够多。我还是砰地撞上了码头，但我没死；而且我觉得他们也没更聪明多少。

items.text: Let me just say that this game is not for everyone. This game may be made by the same people who made NEO Scavenger, but the gameplay is a far cry from that of NS. And that isn't a bad thing. To put it simply, Ostranauts is a strategy/shipbuilding game set in space. The best equivalent I could draw is that it's a more complicated Starsector, with the top down perspective of SS13. The biggest issue that I have with this game is how buggy it is, but with an early access game that's to be expected, and the second biggest issue is how complicated it can be. The navigation systems can be intimidating, and figuring out how a reactor works (along with all the dials, sliders, and switches) can be scary and tedious. Aside from the very beginning there are virtually no tutorials (with the exception of the nav system cheatsheet) and you're left to your own devises past the initial character creation. That's another issue, the character creation. There are three options. Gender, name, and looks. But the only way to customize how you look is using the randomize button (as far as I can tell) and it can be quite annoying to have to keep clicking to find what you want. Another issue is that sometimes the floors on the derelict ships that you find will be totally screwed, and if you manage to dock with a ship on your first run and all of the batteries are dead then you might as well restart. The third issue for me is the batteries. The only way to recharge them is by using a reactor to charge them. Depending on the condition of the ship you dock with (and your nav skills) you might be totally marooned with no hope to recharge you batteries or drive away. There are more issues, but this is already way too long, but they're minor gripes along with everything else, and the devs are very committed and have been releasing patches daily for the past couple of days.TL;DR: Ostranauts is a diamond in the rough with a steep learning curve, however this diamond is uncut and uncircumcised. I wouldn't pay full price for this game in it's current state and recommend that you wait for a sale, or until the game has improved.I give this game a 7/10.
items.text_zh: 我只想说，这款游戏并不适合所有人。这款游戏可能出自制作《NEO Scavenger》的同一批人之手，但玩法与NS相去甚远。而这并不是坏事。简单来说，《Ostranauts》是一款设定在太空中的策略/造船游戏。我能想到的最贴切的类比是，它是一款更复杂的《Starsector》，采用《SS13》的俯视视角。我对这款游戏最大的问题是它有多少bug，但对于一款抢先体验游戏来说这是意料之中的，第二大问题是它可能有多复杂。导航系统可能令人望而生畏，弄清楚反应堆如何运作（连同所有的旋钮、滑块和开关）可能既吓人又繁琐。除了最开始之外，几乎没有教程（导航系统速查表除外），在初始角色创建之后你就只能靠自己摸索了。那又是另一个问题，角色创建。有三个选项。性别、名字和外观。但据我所知，自定义外观的唯一方法就是使用随机按钮，而且为了找到你想要的样子不得不一直点击，这相当烦人。另一个问题是，有时你找到的废弃飞船的地板会完全乱套，如果你第一次出航就成功对接了一艘飞船，而所有电池都没电了，那你不如直接重开。对我来说第三个问题是电池。给它们充电的唯一方法就是用反应堆来充。取决于你对接的飞船的状况（以及你的导航技能），你可能会完全被困住，毫无希望给电池充电或开走。还有更多问题，但这已经太长了，不过它们和其他一切一样都是些小抱怨，而且开发者非常投入，过去几天每天都在发布补丁。TL;DR：《Ostranauts》是一颗未经雕琢的钻石，学习曲线陡峭，然而这颗钻石未经切割也未受割礼。在当前状态下我不会为这款游戏付全价，建议你等打折，或者等游戏有所改进。我给这款游戏打7/10分。

items.text:
I purchased this 11 Sep, 2020.
I can't in good conscience recommend people buy this.
Still very buggy experience in 2025 i spend a lot of time trying to resolve workarounds.
The actual ship parts are not all that much more expanded than in 2022.
None of the crew function correctly, you can't work with them to do basic functionality.
The game play itself is heavily tedious which may be expected for the start of progression, but the methods in which you try to advance your character are also fairly limited and inconsistent, for example there are tiers of welders but not tiers of other tools in the same capacity.
In my opinion the entire social system developed for the game was a waste of time, i want to know 1. what a crew members skills are and 2. how much money they want if they want to work. I do not enjoy the conversation system at all.
I repeatedly would ask people "What type of work do you do" and in response get "she touches your arm", give me a break, i just want to progress.

On a fundamental level ships require a static "docking port". This just feels combersome, allow me to move it and place it how i want. If it's around a design issue, make all stations have long gangplank runways so you can figure out how to connect a ship to it.

On a fundamental level ships are in "zones", this feels like such a technical debt and a harm to the project.
I should simply be able to fly up to a station, and see incoming objects with a periscope.
I should be able to literally fly up to objects, not zone transition.
If this was ingame, players could actually see in a tactile way if their design has issues docking to a ship.

This limitation affects the game so deeply.
It prevents you having primary ships that other smaller ships dock onto, because the docking systems are one to one.
It prevents natural forms of combat seeing actual ships fly over to you, you could see at range with a periscope.
Another limitation seemingly connected to this is the grid system not being able to handle rotations of separate ships in the world.

In the ideal you would be able to fly over, rotate as needed, and approach a docking port.
Or you could have clamps to grab onto someones ship and weld your way in.
Lastly again, crew don't work at all for any basic functionality, with jobs to do on a ship, and their task schedule set to all work, much of the time they just attempt social actions, not doing other jobs they are completely capable of, and do when given the command to.

There are still game bugs like my character disappearing and needing to save and reload to fix.

I love the spirit of the project, i find the implementation tedious and interruptive.
I just want to salvage and upgrade ships in an intuitive format, with a late game of managing crew to do menial jobs.
items.text_zh:

游戏玩法本身极其繁琐，这在 progression 初期也许可以预料，但你尝试推进角色的方法也相当有限且不一致，例如有不同等级的焊接器，但其他工具却没有同等程度的分级。
在我看来，为游戏开发的整个社交系统就是浪费时间，我想知道1. 船员的技能是什么，2. 如果他们想工作，他们想要多少钱。我一点也不喜欢这个对话系统。
我反复问人们“你做什么类型的工作”，得到的回应却是“她碰了碰你的手臂”，饶了我吧，我只想推进进度。

在根本层面上，飞船需要一个静态的“对接端口”。这感觉就是很笨重，让我能移动它并按照我想要的方式放置它。如果这是设计问题，那就让所有空间站都有长长的舷梯跑道，这样你就能想办法把飞船连接到上面。

在根本层面上，飞船处于“区域”中，这感觉像是巨大的技术债，并且对项目有害。
我应该能够直接飞到空间站，并用潜望镜看到迎面而来的物体。
我应该能够真正飞到物体旁边，而不是区域转换。
如果这在游戏内实现，玩家就能以触觉方式实际看到他们的设计在对接飞船时是否有问题。

这个限制如此深刻地影响游戏。
它阻止你拥有其他较小飞船对接上去的主飞船，因为对接系统是一对一的。
它阻止自然形式的战斗，让你看到实际飞船飞向你，你可以用潜望镜在远处看到。
另一个似乎与此相关的限制是网格系统无法处理世界中独立飞船的旋转。

在理想情况下，你应该能够飞过去，按需旋转，并接近对接端口。
或者你可以有夹具抓住某人的飞船，并一路焊接进去。
最后再说一次，船员在任何基本功能上都完全不工作，即使有在飞船上要做的工作，并且他们的任务日程设置为全部工作，很多时候他们只是尝试社交行为，而不做他们完全有能力做的其他工作，并且在被命令时也会做。

仍然有游戏bug，比如我的角色消失，需要保存并重新加载来修复。

我喜欢这个项目的精神，我觉得实现方式繁琐且具有干扰性。
我只想以直观的形式打捞和升级飞船，并在后期管理船员去做琐碎的工作。

items.text:
WARNING1: This game is extremely early access, expect lots of bugs and buy only if you want to support and have faith in the developer
WARNING2: This game is very hard, unforgiving and with very little hand holding. It is like a bastard child between a rouge-like and an old-school adventure game: Lots of very hard puzzles and if you make a single mistake there is a 95% chance you will die.

The first time I played, I accidentally disassembled a part of the hull and quickly died in the cold vacuum of space.

The second time, I accidentally backed my salvage pod into some sort of hard object, ruptured the hull and quickly died in the cold vacuum of space.

The third time, I got the salvage pod moving in the right direction! But I overshoot the target (some old derelict ship). Then my battery died and everything went pitch black. The compact darkness made it impossible for me to switch to a spare battery (apparently, I should have bought a work light). Trapped in my dark tin-can, the only thing I could look forward to was a slow death in the cold vacuum of space.

Forth time, I made sure to bring a light, a crow bar, some extra rations and hull patches. I did a practice run on the battery switching and it went smooth as butter, Now I was prepared for everything! This time I moved a towards the old derelict in a more controlled manner. Alarms started to go off as I neared the target and switched the nav console over to docking. In a flurry of more or less chaotic manoeuvring and a few bounces against the target, I managed to finally lock my docking clamps. Success! Once I left the docking console, I quickly realised that all my less-than-gentle docking attempts had completely smashed the airlook, air was seeping out and once again I died a quick death in the cold vacuum of space.

Fifth time, I made a perfect smooth docking, put on my airtight helmet and my work-light in order to explore the derelict ship. After some wandering I found what I was looking for, the reactor core. This was the first time I booted a fusion reactor and ships power reserve was quite low, but how hard could it be? Turns out out it was pretty hard. To many failed tempts led to me completely draining what was left on the derelicts batteries. Guess what was also drained? the batteries on the salvage pod! slow death by cold vacuum of space here I come!


With that out of the way: this is an amazing, one of a kind proto-game and I have had a lot of fun with it so far. Even in this unfinished state there is a solid game loop and the atmosphere is extraordinary (much thanks to the amazing music and sound effects).

EDIT: The first time I posted this review, I accidentally clicked the "receieved product for free" checkbox. That was a mistake, I did NOT recieve this product for free.
items.text_zh:
警告1：这款游戏处于极其早期的抢先体验阶段，预计会有大量bug，只有在你想要支持开发者并对其有信心时才购买
警告2：这款游戏非常困难、毫不留情，几乎没有引导。它就像一款roguelike和一款老派冒险游戏的私生子：有大量非常困难的谜题，如果你犯了一个错误，就有95%的几率会死。

我第一次玩的时候，不小心拆掉了船体的一部分，很快就在寒冷的太空真空中死去了。

第二次，我不小心把我的打捞舱倒车撞上了某种坚硬的物体，船体破裂，很快就在寒冷的太空真空中死去了。

第三次，我让打捞舱朝正确的方向移动了！但我冲过了目标（某艘古老的废弃飞船）。然后我的电池没电了，一切都变得漆黑一片。紧凑的黑暗让我无法切换到备用电池（显然，我本该买一盏工作灯）。被困在我的黑暗铁罐里，我唯一能指望的就是在寒冷的太空真空中缓慢死去。

第四次，我确保带上了灯、撬棍、一些额外的口粮和船体补丁。我做了一次电池切换的练习，顺利得像黄油一样，现在我为一切做好了准备！这次我以更有控制的方式朝那艘古老的废弃飞船移动。当我接近目标并把导航控制台切换到对接模式时，警报开始响起。在一阵或多或少混乱的机动以及几次撞上目标之后，我终于锁上了对接夹。成功！一旦我离开对接控制台，我很快意识到我那些不够温柔的对接尝试已经完全砸坏了气闸，空气正在泄漏，于是我又一次在寒冷的太空真空中迅速死去了。

第五次，我完美而平稳地完成了对接，戴上我的气密头盔和工作灯，去探索那艘废弃飞船。游荡了一阵后，我找到了我要找的东西，反应堆核心。这是我第一次启动聚变反应堆，而飞船的电力储备相当低，但这能有多难呢？事实证明相当难。太多次失败的尝试导致我完全耗尽了废弃飞船上电池剩下的电量。猜猜还有什么也被耗尽了？打捞舱上的电池！在寒冷的太空真空中缓慢死去，我来了！


说完这些：这是一款令人惊叹的、独一无二的原型游戏，到目前为止我玩得非常开心。即使在这个未完成的状态下，也有一个扎实的游戏循环，氛围也非同凡响（很大程度上要归功于出色的音乐和音效）。

编辑：我第一次发布这条评测时，不小心勾选了“免费收到产品”的复选框。那是个错误，我并没有免费收到这款产品。

items.text:
Caveat emptor: this game is in super ultra bleeding edge early release. Lots of forthcoming features are not implemented yet. There's still weird bugs. If you're looking for a mature Blue Bottle Games title, go play NEO Scavenger and come back in a few months once the rest of us have playtested and QA'd this game into shape. 

With that being said:

Ostranauts is an effective, entertaining spiritual successor to NEO Scavenger. You begin by using a sink to choose your appearance and gender/pronouns (you can be male, female, or nonbinary - big upgrade from the original!) A randomized personal history generator now precedes the trait selector, and your choices when generating your background influence how much starting cash you have available to kit yourself out before going hunting for a derelict to fix up and call your own. 

Scavenging now has additional layers of nuance. You're in space, so you have to keep an eye on your oxygen and CO2 levels, and make sure to stay pressurized! The game is no longer strictly turn-based, so timing does come into play, especially when piloting your ship. There's still plenty of opportunities to pause and size up the situation, and you can also fast-forward through tedious jobs like pulling and reinstalling batteries, laying power conduits, etc.

There's also now a social element to the game. I haven't fully grasped the interaction system - it's pretty complex! - but in order to get your ship off the ground, you likely need to hire a qualified pilot to help you. NPCs won't just come with you when you ask; they have to be on friendly terms with you or else they'll shrug you off. Some of them appear to be predatory and will use you to make themselves feel better. Yikes!

---

In summary: if you were a fan of NEO Scavenger, get in on this game while it's still in EA. There's already a lot here, and it's just the tip of the iceberg.
items.text_zh:
买家自慎：这款游戏处于超级极端前沿的抢先体验阶段。许多即将推出的功能尚未实现。仍然存在奇怪的bug。如果你在寻找一款成熟的Blue Bottle Games作品，去玩NEO Scavenger，等几个月后我们其他人把这款游戏试玩和QA到成型再回来。

话虽如此：

Ostranauts是NEO Scavenger一个有效、有趣的的精神续作。你一开始使用一个水槽来选择你的外观和性别/代词（你可以是男性、女性或非二元性别——相比原作是巨大的升级！）一个随机化的个人历史生成器现在先于特质选择器，你在生成背景时的选择会影响你在出发寻找一艘废弃飞船来修复并据为己有之前，有多少起始现金来装备自己。

拾荒现在有了额外的细微层次。你在太空中，所以你必须留意你的氧气和二氧化碳水平，并确保保持加压！游戏不再严格是回合制的，所以时机确实会起作用，尤其是在驾驶你的飞船时。仍然有很多机会暂停并评估情况，你也可以快进跳过像拆卸和重新安装电池、铺设电力导管等繁琐工作。

游戏现在还有一个社交元素。我还没有完全掌握互动系统——它相当复杂！——但为了让你的飞船起飞，你很可能需要雇佣一名合格的飞行员来帮助你。NPC不会在你要求时就跟你走；他们必须与你关系友好，否则他们会对你耸耸肩不理。他们中有些人似乎是掠夺性的，会利用你来让自己感觉更好。哎呀！

---

总结：如果你是NEO Scavenger的粉丝，趁这款游戏还在EA阶段就加入吧。这里已经有很多内容了，而这只是冰山一角。

items.text:
Disclaimer: I was provided with an early copy of the game for playtesting. I have bought my own copy at launch to give away. 

Space: The Final Frontier or it was until an ablation cascade cut of the colonies from Earth. While Phillip Kindred is fighting for survival in Michigan. You (yes, you! dear reader) are a salvager on the asteroid 1036-Ganymed. A fate some might even consider worse than death. When one fateful day working in the scrapyard of the asteroid’s station, K-Leg, you stumble upon a working escape pod. Thinking you would rather test your luck in the vast ocean of darkness that is space than to die during a salvaging operation. Forge your own path in space! Maybe you might even have your own ship someday and make some friends along the way.

Ostranauts is a simple concept, but a brilliant idea. A Space-sim based on the idea of running your own customizable ship but owning one of these babies is neither cheap nor easy. You will be forced to salvage other ships for parts or valuables, and you will not be able to handle it alone. Besides keeping your ship from falling apart, you will also need to manage your crew. Keeping them from each other’s throats and as you travel through the deep unknown, who knows what opportunities might present themselves?

This game launches in Early Access. The main gameplay loop currently consists of creating your character, flying your ship, salvaging derelicts for parts or money, repairing a derelict, and being able to recruit and socialize with your crew members.

I will be honest with the fact that the game is buggy and that is still a bit rough around the edges, but for me the EA forms a good basis for the game and that by supporting the devs this game Is going to be a very unique experience. Blue Bottle Games delivered with Neo Scavenger and they will deliver with Ostranauts.
items.text_zh:
免责声明：我获赠了一份游戏的早期副本用于试玩。我在发售时自己买了一份用来送人。

太空：最后的边疆，或者说在烧蚀级联切断了殖民地与地球的联系之前是这样。当菲利普·金德里德在密歇根为生存而战时。你（没错，就是你！亲爱的读者）是1036-木卫三小行星上的一名打捞者。一种有些人甚至可能认为比死亡更糟糕的命运。当某一天在小行星空间站K-Leg的废料场工作时，你偶然发现了一个还能用的逃生舱。想着与其在一次打捞作业中死去，不如在太空这片浩瀚的黑暗海洋中碰碰运气。在太空中开辟你自己的道路！也许有一天你甚至能拥有自己的飞船，并在此过程中结交一些朋友。

Ostranauts是一个简单的概念，却是一个绝妙的想法。一款基于经营你自己可定制飞船这一理念的太空模拟游戏，但拥有一艘这样的宝贝既不便宜也不容易。你将被迫从其他飞船上打捞零件或贵重物品，而且你无法独自应付。除了不让你的飞船散架，你还需要管理你的船员。让他们不互相掐架，而当你穿越深邃的未知时，谁知道会有什么机遇出现呢？

这款游戏以抢先体验形式推出。目前主要的玩法循环包括创建你的角色、驾驶你的飞船、从废弃飞船打捞零件或换钱、修理一艘废弃飞船，以及能够招募船员并与他们社交。

我会诚实地说明这款游戏有bug，而且仍然有些粗糙，但对我来说抢先体验版为游戏奠定了良好的基础，并且通过支持开发者，这款游戏将会成为一种非常独特的体验。Blue Bottle Games凭借Neo Scavenger交出了答卷，他们也会凭借Ostranauts交出答卷。
